Tidal — an interactive character ocean for junnhwan's blog

Fish profiles and glyph vocabulary:
ASCII Ocean by GqqQq-Q
https://github.com/GqqQq-Q/dsh-ascii-ocean
Source revision: 99b67287df5d1952782493e4ecddf3b60305d6d6
License: MIT (as declared by the upstream package and LICENSE).

ASCII Ocean credits the earlier ascii-sharks visualization:
https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks

src/lib/ascii-ocean/fish-art.ts adapts the shark, koi and goldfish body-width
profiles, fin proportions and character vocabulary from ASCII Ocean.
The glyph atlas, spine projection, mouse-following and habitat behavior,
procedural rocks / seaweed, manta geometry, flowing contours and ripples
are implemented for this blog. No third-party images are included.
